description: Separate open, high, low, and close views of BRK's block-level BTC/USD price series for each supported time period. Heights before 340,000 use baked historical exchange prices; later heights use an on-chain oracle that estimates price from round-USD transaction-output patterns. Closing Bitcoin price for each supported time period, including daily periods. A populated period uses its final block-level price; an empty period is null. Reported in USD per BTC.
